login.title: Sign in
login.text: Enter your phone number. We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
login.phoneHint: The number registered with your health service.
login.unknownNumber: This number isn't registered as a health worker. Check it, or ask your district office.
login.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.demoText: Tap a number to fill it in. The code is {{code}}.

home.urgent_one: {{count}} reading this week said refer today
home.urgent_other: {{count}} readings this week said refer today

patients.title: Patients
patients.search: Search by name, community or phone
patients.empty: No patients yet. Register the first one.
patients.notFound: This patient is not on this phone.

patient.noEvidence: No recording: a witness confirmed it.

newPatient.title: Register a patient
newPatient.consentText: Explain in the patient's language why you keep their record, and that they can say no.
newPatient.consentGiven: The patient agreed to have their health record kept.
newPatient.knowsBirthDate: Does the patient know their date of birth?
newPatient.consentPromise: Their record stays on this phone until it is sent securely to the health service. Only their health workers can see it.
newPatient.personText: Fill in what the patient tells you. If they don't know their birth date, enter their age.
newPatient.placeText: So the right health worker and facility can follow up.
newPatient.statement: We would like to keep your health record on this phone and send it securely to the Ghana Health Service, so your health workers can follow up on your care. Only your health workers can see it. You can say no, and you can ask us to stop at any time. Do you agree?

vitals.title: Record vitals
vitals.referToday: Refer the patient to a health facility today.
vitals.recheck: Measure again at the next visit and tell the nurse.
vitals.photos: Photos of a wound or rash
vitals.photosHint: Optional. Up to 3. Only for the patient's care; ask before taking them.

sync.title: Sync
sync.allSent: Everything on this phone has been sent.

surveillance.title: District summary
surveillance.demo: Demo data until the surveillance API is live
surveillance.offline: The summary needs a connection. Try again when you're online.
surveillance.partial: Some weeks had fewer than 5 patients and are not counted, to protect privacy.
surveillance.empty: No data for your district yet.
surveillance.privacy: Counts under 5 are hidden so no patient can be identified (Act 843 s.24(3)).
surveillance.signalText: {{now}} patients with fever last week, against an average of {{avg}} in the 4 weeks before. Check with the district team.

profile.title: Profile
profile.photoHint: Your photo stays on this phone.
profile.photoError: That picture couldn't be used. Try another one.

pwa.updateText: Reload to use it. Your saved records stay on this phone.
pwa.offlineText: You can open the app and record patients without internet.
pwa.installText: Add it to your home screen to open it like an app.

errors.consent: The patient must agree before you save their record.
errors.dateOfBirth: Enter a date in the past.
errors.range: This value looks wrong. Check the measurement.
errors.future: Choose a time in the future.
errors.evidence: Record, sign or photograph the patient's consent first.

routeError.title: This screen didn't load
routeError.text: Check your connection and try again. Your saved records are safe on this phone.

registered.title: Registered!
registered.text: The record is saved on this phone and will be sent when there is network.

refer.title: Refer today
refer.text: {{name}}'s readings need a health facility today.
refer.tip1: Explain to the patient why they need to go today, in their language.
refer.tip2: If they cannot travel, call the facility and tell the nurse on duty.

chart.title: Blood pressure
chart.aria_one: Blood pressure over {{count}} visit, latest {{sys}}/{{dia}} mmHg
chart.aria_other: Blood pressure over {{count}} visits, latest {{sys}}/{{dia}} mmHg

welcome.draftNote: Twi, Ewe and Hausa are first drafts that native speakers are still checking.

code.title: Enter the code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.wrong: That code isn't right. Check the SMS and try again.

capture.spokenHint: Read the statement, then record the patient saying yes. Up to 30 seconds.
capture.noMic: This phone can't record sound. Ask someone else who heard the patient agree to give their name below.
capture.signHint: The patient signs with a finger.
capture.thumbHint: Press the patient's inked thumb on the paper consent form, then photograph it.
capture.witnessHint: Optional. Someone else who heard the patient agree.
capture.witnessNeeded: Needed when there is no recording.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Who opened, created or changed patient records, and every refused attempt.
audit.search: Search by health worker or patient
audit.onPhone: on this phone, not uploaded yet
audit.serverNote: This phone's record of access. The server keeps the full log in an append-only, hash-chained table, so entries can't be changed or removed without it showing.
